name: Example payroll portal
_comment: schema: the fields to pull out of the intake email (key → description). pages: the vendor's forms in order; each submit is gated. tracker: a CSV or a web form that gets one row per onboarding. $owner, $ref, $date and 'literal' are the special column sources.

schema.state: US state of incorporation, two letters
schema.frequency: Pay frequency: Weekly, Biweekly, Semimonthly or Monthly
schema.admin_name: Full name of the person who will administer payroll
schema.headcount: Number of employees to be paid
